name: Hieroglyphs: colours
_about: THE PAINTER'S PALETTE (glyphs.js): the six pigments Egyptian painters had -- red and yellow ochre, Egyptian blue, green (malachite, later a frit), carbon black, gypsum white -- and the shades they mixed, by name; then the ROLES every sign may use, each a name of the palette (a sign or a part sets its own roles: a woman's skin is yellow, a man's red). `modes`: ways of painting a whole text -- one colour for every sign (tomb walls in blue, in green), a red draft of outlines only, sunk relief in the stone -- each { fill, line, detail } (null: not drawn).
